import unittest

from solution import scan_part_codes


class ScanPartCodesTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_normalization_order_and_repetition(self):
        text = "Part: ABC-1234-P; PART = zzz-9999-j; part:ABC-1234-P"
        self.assertEqual(list(scan_part_codes(text)), ["ABC1234P", "ZZZ9999J", "ABC1234P"])

    def test_empty_and_no_matches(self):
        self.assertEqual(list(scan_part_codes("")), [])
        self.assertEqual(list(scan_part_codes("part: AAA-0000-D")), [])
        self.assertEqual(list(scan_part_codes("unrelated text")), [])

    def test_checksum_boundaries(self):
        self.assertEqual(list(scan_part_codes("part=AAA-0000-C part: ZZZ-9999-J")),
                         ["AAA0000C", "ZZZ9999J"])

    def test_rejects_embedded_tokens_and_malformed_codes(self):
        text = (
            "xpart:AAA-0000-C "
            "partx:AAA-0000-C "
            "part:AAA-0000-C9 "
            "part:AAA-0000-Cx "
            "part:1AA-0000-C "
            "part:AAA_0000_C "
            "part:AAAA-0000-C"
        )
        self.assertEqual(list(scan_part_codes(text)), [])

    def test_ascii_only_letters_and_digits(self):
        self.assertEqual(list(scan_part_codes("part: ÅAA-0000-C part: AAA-٠٠٠٠-C")), [])

    def test_returns_iterator_and_does_not_mutate_text(self):
        text = "part: ABC-1234-P"
        original = text
        result = scan_part_codes(text)
        self.assertIs(iter(result), result)
        self.assertEqual(next(result), "ABC1234P")
        with self.assertRaises(StopIteration):
            next(result)
        self.assertEqual(text, original)

    def test_non_string_raises_type_error(self):
        for value in (None, 123, b"part: AAA-0000-C", ["part"]):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    scan_part_codes(value)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
